description: Get one Library item (metadata + signed file URL). A forged mesh shows its game-ready verdict first (meta.gameReady: ready, missing checks; meta.collider). A GripForge Compute asset also returns `compute` {edit_url, family: original + colour / material / polygon versions}.

id.description: Library id (lib_…), or the stable name of an official asset with its range (asset.preload.preloader@^1: the highest published version in range), or a slot <kit>/<slot> (the official an administrator designated for it)

workspace_id.description: Explicit workspace id. The key must have access to it.

name: gripforge_library_get
